measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspect of religion or faith. The benchmark (MLLM-Bench) measures multimodal LLM capabilities across six cognitive levels inspired by Bloom's Taxonomy: perception, understanding, applying, analyzing, evaluating, and creation, with a focus on open-ended tasks.
